title.zh: Azure's Weakest Link – Five Full Cross-Tenant Compromises
title.en: Azure's Weakest Link – Five Full Cross-Tenant Compromises

current_state.zh: Binary Security publishes research detailing five full cross-tenant compromise chains in Azure, tracing them to path traversal and IDOR flaws and recommending mitigations such as randomized resource naming.
